adversarial_audit.objection: A dense no-information-set code may have many Smith factors.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Pair coverage makes the entire quotient cyclic.

adversarial_audit.objection: The one Smith factor may grow with width.
adversarial_audit.resolution: A modulus at least five has multilevel binomial mass below one quarter.

adversarial_audit.objection: A rank-deficient lattice evades the modular bound.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Its exact signed layer is too small once n>=9.

adversarial_audit.objection: Bounded abelianization proves bounded full presentation.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False as a general group-theoretic inference; nonabelian kernels can be large and remain the next proof obligation.

all_depth_certificate.cyclic_quotient_derivation: All coordinate classes equal one generator up to sign, so Z^n/L is finite cyclic or infinite cyclic.
all_depth_certificate.finite_quotient_signed_congruence: For order D>2, unique signs sigma_i give every codeword signed weight zero modulo D.
all_depth_certificate.infinite_quotient_layer_bound: An infinite quotient places C in one exact signed-weight layer of size at most C(n,floor(n/2)), below 2^(n-2) for n>=9.
all_depth_certificate.nine_bit_anticoncentration_bound: Conditioning outside nine bits leaves binomial levels separated by at least five; their maximum mass is (C(9,0)+C(9,5))/2^9.
all_depth_certificate.no_information_set_pair_coverage: Failure after omitting {i,j} gives a collision supported exactly on {i,j}; hence e_i=+/-e_j in the incidence quotient.
all_depth_certificate.normalized_code_scope: 0 in C subset F_2^n, |C|=2^(n-2), minimum distance at least two, and no injective projection onto n-2 coordinates
all_depth_certificate.small_width_direct_bound: For widths 5,6,7,8 the maxima are respectively 2,7,22,57, all below 2^(n-2).

claim_gate.reason: The abelian incidence quotient is bounded, but its nonabelian ordered-presentation kernel is not yet classified.

falsifiers_triggered: The incidence quotient cannot have multiple independent Smith factors.
Its finite order cannot grow beyond four asymptotically.
Rank-deficient normalized families cannot persist beyond width eight.

proof_obligations.resolution: The cyclic quotient has order at most four for n>=9.
Central-binomial anticoncentration confines infinite quotient controls to n<=8.
Bound the commutator-subgroup kernel after the cyclic abelian quotient reduction, or construct a growing-rank family.

summary: Proved that every all-depth normalized codimension-two no-information-set family has cyclic incidence torsion of order at most four.

theorem_contract.asymptotic_bound: For n>=9 the lattice has full rank and finite index at most four.
theorem_contract.quotient_classification: Pair coverage forces the incidence quotient to be cyclic.
theorem_contract.research_consequence: No all-depth candidate can obtain vanishing loss merely from a growing Smith invariant of the codeword incidence lattice.
theorem_contract.scope: 0 in C subset F_2^n, |C|=2^(n-2), minimum distance at least two, and no injective projection onto n-2 coordinates
theorem_contract.scope_limit: Unnormalized supports and nonabelian residual presentation rank are not controlled by this abelian theorem.
